items.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
items.title_zh: 重新思考推理密集型检索：评估并推进智能体搜索系统中的检索器
items.summary: Yale researchers release BRIGHT-Pro, an expert-annotated benchmark that adds multi-aspect gold evidence and agentic search protocols to reasoning-intensive retrieval evaluation. They also introduce RTriever-Synth and a LoRA-tuned RTriever-4B built on Qwen3-Embedding-4B.

items.title: Echo: KV-Cache-Free Associative Recall with Spectral Koopman Operators
items.title_zh: Echo：基于谱 Koopman 算子的无 KV 缓存联想召回
items.summary: Echo replaces attention-layer KV caching with Spectral Koopman Attention, which fits a spectral linear system to key-value history via kernel ridge regression and retrieves through a learned power-iterated filter in constant memory. At 50M parameters, SKA-augmented models reach 100% retrieval accuracy on multi-query associative recall with distractor gaps of 4,096 tokens and 32 KV pairs, where pure Mamba-2 stays near chance.

items.title: Self-Driving Datasets: From 20 Million Papers to Nuanced Biomedical Knowledge at Scale
items.title_zh: 自驱动数据集：从两千万篇论文到规模化细粒度生物医学知识
items.summary: The work tags 4.5 billion entities across 19 categories in a 22.5-million-paper PubMed corpus using nine biomedical ontologies, adds hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, and introduces Starling, a multi-agent deep-research system that designs its own filters and extraction schemas. Across six tasks Starling produces about 6.3 million records, with frontier-model rejection of 0.6-7.7%, below measured error rates on curated counterparts.

items.title: Beyond the Black Box: Interpretability of Agentic AI Tool Use
items.title_zh: 超越黑箱：智能体 AI 工具调用的可解释性
items.summary: The work builds a mechanistic-interpretability toolkit of sparse autoencoders and linear probes that reads model states before each action to infer whether a tool is needed and how risky the next call is. It is applied to GPT-OSS 20B and Gemma 3 27B using multi-step traces from NVIDIA's Nemotron function-calling dataset.

items.title: Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries
items.title_zh: 技能组：面向智能体技能库的分组结构化技能检索
items.summary: GoSkills changes the agent-facing retrieval object from a flat skill list to role-labeled execution groups built from a typed skill graph, rendering Start, Support, Check and Avoid fields without changing the downstream agent. Across SkillsBench, ALFWorld and Terminal-Bench 2 with six backbones it reports the highest mean reward or accuracy in every benchmark-backbone setting.

items.title: ReasonLab: A Controlled and Auditable Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Multiple-Choice QA
items.title_zh: ReasonLab：对多项选择问答提示技术的受控可审计评估
items.summary: ReasonLab makes prompting technique a first-class experimental variable and retains every generation, covering eight techniques, 10 MCQA datasets, 27 model configurations and 480,927 evaluations at temperature zero. It finds prompting technique is a minor determinant of accuracy, while enabling model reasoning is worth up to 12.74 points.

items.title: CreativityBench: Evaluating Agent Creative Reasoning via Affordance-Based Tool Repurposing
items.title_zh: CreativityBench：通过基于可供性的工具再利用评估智能体创造性推理
items.summary: CreativityBench, built by UIUC researchers, tests whether LLMs can repurpose objects by reasoning about affordances; across 10 models and 14,000 tasks, models choose plausible objects but miss the parts and mechanisms required.

items.title: Delulu: A Verified Multi-Lingual Benchmark for Code Hallucination Detection in Fill-in-the-Middle Tasks
items.title_zh: Delulu：面向填充中间任务代码幻觉检测的已验证多语言基准
items.summary: Delulu is a verified benchmark of 1,951 fill-in-the-middle samples across seven languages and four hallucination types, with Docker containers checking that golden completions compile while hallucinated variants fail. The strongest of 11 open-weight models reaches only 84.5% pass@1.

items.title: Research on Security Enhancement Methods for Adversarial Robust Large Language Model Intelligent Agents for Medical Decision-Making Tasks
items.title_zh: 面向医疗决策任务的对抗鲁棒大语言模型智能体安全增强方法研究
items.summary: ARSM-Agent is a full-link security framework for medical decision agents spanning input risk perception, medical evidence constraint, knowledge-consistency verification, confidence reweighting and adversarial feedback. Under semantic perturbation, prompt injection, drug-name confusion and false-evidence attacks it reports an 8.7% overall attack success rate and a 0.91 knowledge-consistency score.

items.title: freestylefly/wesight
items.summary: wesight is an open-source desktop AI agent workspace offering one-click setup for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent plus custom LLM model routing; it has 959 stars and 211 forks on GitHub Trending.

items.title: Parloa builds service agents customers want to talk to
items.title_zh: Parloa 打造客户愿意对话的服务智能体
items.summary: Parloa uses OpenAI models to power scalable, voice-driven customer service agents that enterprises can design, simulate and deploy for reliable real-time interactions.
